questions.question: What was the total amount of estate taxes collected in California in fiscal year 2023, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_data_book_gross_collections_by_state_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 5', header=None)
cal_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California']
result = int(cal_row.iloc[0, 9])

questions.question: Between Texas and New York, which state generated higher total gross IRS collections in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_data_book_gross_collections_by_state_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 5', header=None)
tx_val = df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Texas', 1].values[0]
ny_val = df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'New York', 1].values[0]
result = 'Texas' if tx_val > ny_val else 'New York'

questions.question: Which three states had the highest business income tax collections in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_data_book_gross_collections_by_state_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 5', header=None)
states_df = df.iloc[6:57].copy()
states_df[2] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[2])
result = states_df.sort_values(by=2, ascending=False).head(3)[0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: Among the 50 states and the District of Columbia, how many had total IRS collections of more than 100 billion dollars (100,000,000 thousand dollars) in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_data_book_gross_collections_by_state_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 5', header=None)
states_df = df.iloc[6:57].copy()
states_df[1] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[1])
result = int((states_df[1] > 100000000).sum())

questions.question: Did Florida collect more excise tax revenue than California in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_data_book_gross_collections_by_state_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 5', header=None)
fl_excise = df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida', 11].values[0]
ca_excise = df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California', 11].values[0]
result = 'yes' if fl_excise > ca_excise else 'no'

questions.question: What was the combined business income tax collection for New York and New Jersey in fiscal year 2023, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_data_book_gross_collections_by_state_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 5', header=None)
